content.text: {"scope":"The bike repair tracker running on the owner's computer.","assets":["Customer contact details","Repair job records"],"entryPoints":["The sign-in page","The repair job pages"],"trustBoundaries":["Between the browser and the application"],"summary":"Two realistic risks, both already covered by the built-in protections.","threats":[{"stride":"spoofing","target":"browser","description":"Someone who is not a mechanic tries to open the repair job pages by guessing the address.","likelihood":"medium","impact":"medium","riskLevel":"medium","residualRisk":"low","status":"mitigated","mitigations":[{"control":"PAT-DENY-BY-DEFAULT-ROUTES","description":"Every page requires sign-in unless it is explicitly public.","requirementIds":["V8.2.1"]}],"actionItems":[]},{"stride":"information-disclosure","target":"flow-browser-app","description":"Someone on the same network reads the traffic between the browser and the application.","likelihood":"low","impact":"high","riskLevel":"medium","residualRisk":"low","status":"mitigated","mitigations":[{"control":"PAT-TRUST-ZONES","description":"The application only listens on this computer, so there is no network traffic to read.","requirementIds":[]}],"actionItems":[]}]}
